content: Vite dev server proxy (server.proxy in vite.config) is generally preferred over relying on backend CORS for local dev: frontend code calls relative paths (e.g. fetch('/products')), proxy forwards to target (e.g. http://localhost:5000), avoids hardcoding full backend URLs, and behaves closer to a same-origin production deployment (e.g. behind a reverse proxy). Backend CORS is still needed for any deployment where frontend and API are genuinely cross-origin in production.
